get_special_tokens_document: get all special document tokens including section headers, picture classifications, code languages, and location tokens
get_special_tokens_table: get all special table tokens including cell labels and OTSL cell types
create_token_name_from_doc_item_label: create a token name string from a DocItemLabel enum value and optional section header level
get_location: get a location token string from a bounding box and page dimensions
get_location_token: get a single location token from a normalized float value and normalization factor
